text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As a backlash from pushing herself too 
hard, Wonder Acute's body wouldn't move as 
she wanted. Driving force toward a goal is 
vital for recovery, but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"To become the hope for those striving to 
make a comeback through running." Her goal 
is steadily coming within reach. Just 
then...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon announced she would be taking 
on Dubai's international GⅠ race. The goal 
of having a rematch with her was now out 
of reach.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the Kashiwa Kinen fast approaching, 
her recovery isn't going well. Her strong 
drive to run has faded too. What will 
become of Wonder Acute?
